subtitle: DESIGN WITH THE PEOPLE WHO LIVE THE SYSTEM
title: Policy becomes real through people's experience
paragraph: We combine what the data measures with what people experience.

orbitItems.description: Design ideas with users, client teams and technical stakeholders.

orbitItems.label: Prototype
orbitItems.description: Build the smallest useful representation of the policy, service or model.

orbitItems.description: Keep what works. Change what doesn't.

iterateText: Keep what works. Change what doesn't.
questionText: Why technically correct reforms still fail
questionAnswer: Even the most well-designed policies fail when they don't account for the lived experience of the people who must implement and use them. Technical correctness alone is insufficient without human-centered service design connecting people, process, data, tech, and finance.
